name: Subway Rotisserie-Style Chicken on Italian White
whyItWorks: Tender hand-pulled white and dark chicken meat that is seasoned simply and heated. Soft and easy to chew without the tough fibrous texture of whole fried cuts.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the chicken warmed on Artisan Italian bread. Skip all raw crunchy veggies during a flare, or add peeled cucumber slices in remission.
